title: Mechanical appliances.
officialText:
Access to mechanical appliances installed in under-floor areas, in attic spaces and on roofs or
elevated structures shall be in accordance with the New York City Mechanical Code.
SECTION BC 1210
SURROUNDING MATERIALS
